AGENDA
REGULAR MEETING OF THE TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
OF THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
PUBLIC WORKS DIRECTOR'S REPORT
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
Members of the audience are invited to address the Committee at this time on items that are not otherwise on the agenda. Per the California Government Code Section 54954.2, the Traffic Safety Committee is prohibited from discussing or taking immediate action on any item not on the agenda unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency nature, or the need to take action arose subsequent to the posting of the agenda.
NEW BUSINESS
1.
CONSIDER THE REQUEST FOR PARKING RESTRICTION ON NAVAJO PLACE
Recommendation:   That the Traffic Safety Committee consider the request for parking restrictions on one side of Navajo Place from Via La Selva to the beginning of the “circle” (approximately 520 feet northeast of Via La Selva) and provide direction to staff. CHAIR AND COMMITTEE MEMBER REPORTS
This portion of the agenda is reserved for the Chair and Committee Members to provide comments, reports on community activities, subcommittees, and propose topics to be calendared on a future Traffic Safety Committee agenda.
STAFF REPORT
ADJOURNMENT TO WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 6, 2024, AT 6:30 P.M.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California, that the foregoing agenda was posted on the City Hall Bulletin Boards located by front door located at 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274, and on the City's Website (pvestates.org) not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting in accordance with Government Code Section 54954.2. Dated this 29th day of August 2024. Tameka Cook, City Clerk
Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk's Office at (310) 378-0383, at least 72 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
Actions taken by this Committee are advisory.

minutes_text:
September 4, 2024
  6:30 p.m.
  City Hall Council Chambers
  340 Palos Verdes Drive West
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

  ACTION MINUTES FOR THE SEPTEMBER 4, 2024
  REGULAR MEETING OF THE TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
  OF THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

CALL TO ORDER
The meeting was called to order at 6:30 p.m. on September 4, 2024.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

PRESENT: Chair Lee, Vice Chair Unno, Committee Members Windman, Gargas and
Amos

ABSENT: None

ALSO PRESENT: City Engineer Loriso and Acting Captain Belba

APPROVAL OF AGENDA
Moved by Windman and seconded by Gargas to approve the agenda as presented. The
motion unanimously carried by the following vote:

AYES:  Lee, Unno, Windman, Gargas, and Amos
NO:  None
ABSENT:  None

PUBLIC WORK DIRECTOR’S REPORT

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

NEW BUSINESS

TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
REGULAR MEETING OF SEPTEMBER 4, 2024
   1. CONSIDER THE REQUEST FOR PARKING RESTRICTIONS ON ONE SIDE
  OF NAVAJO PLACE FROM VIA LA SELVA TO THE BEGINNING OF THE
  “CIRCLE” (APPROXIMATELY 520 FEET NORTHEAST OF VIA LA SELVA)
  Action: Motion made by Amos and seconded by Gargas to approve the
  installation of parking restrictions on the east and south side of Navajo Place from
  the westerly segment of Via La Selva to the beginning of the “circle” (approximately 520
  feet northeast of Via La Selva). The motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Lee, Unno, Windman, Gargas, and Amos
  NO:  None
  ABSENT:  None

COMMITTEE CHAIR AND COMMITTEE MEMBER REPORTS

ADJOURNMENT TO THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 6, 2024 AT 6:30 P.M.
Motion to adjourn by Chair Lee. The motion unanimously carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Lee, Unno, Windman, Gargas, and Amos
  NO:  None
  ABSENT:  None

TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
REGULAR MEETING OF SEPTEMBER 4, 2024
